fact: A tender notice published on 27 October 2025 (closing 19 November 2025) invited bids for the procurement and implementation of an Education Management Information System and Learning Management System with 36 months' maintenance support, so a national EMIS was still being procured.
title: PROCUREMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION OF EDUCATION MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM,LEARNING MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND PERFECTION MAINTENANCE SUPPORT FOR 36 MONTHS
